errors.evidence: The categories on the y-axis are not sorted in alphabetical order. In Cyrillic, 'Резервни части и консумативи' (starting with Р) should come before 'Суровини и материали' (starting with С).

errors.evidence: The description makes an assumption about the units of the x-axis. While the caption mentions 'average ratings', this is still an interpretation not explicitly stated in the visual elements of the chart itself.
The chart is a horizontal bar chart. The bars have length, not height. Using 'height' is incorrect for this chart orientation.
